# `aitbc gpu update`

Update GPU registration with new pricing or status.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc gpu update [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--gpu-id` | text | — | yes | The Gpu id. |
| `--pricing` | text | — | no | Updated pricing model (JSON string) |
| `--status` | text | — | no | Update GPU status |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc gpu update --gpu-id <gpu_id>
```
